correctness.rationale: For each unselected edge uv of K_n, adjacency count in L(K_n) equals d_F(u)+d_F(v), so F is a fort iff its K_n degree sequence has no simultaneous isolated vertex and leaf. Nonspanning minimal forts reduce to one nonspanning cycle; spanning minimal forts are exactly minimal edge covers, equivalent to spanning star forests. Both families are minimal, and the labeled set construction yields the exact component EGF with the size-two center-overcount correction. All candidate sets and coefficients were compared against direct original-definition enumeration for 3<=n<=6; infinite correctness follows from the proof, not finite checks.
